catalog: Create a production fantasy game EQUIPMENT ICON ATLAS, transparent background, 1024x1536 portrait. EXACT GRID: 5 equal columns and 15 equal rows (75 cells). Each icon isolated and centered, consistent 15% transparent padding, no text no labels no borders no shadows behind. Hand-painted crisp readable fantasy metal matching reference sword. Columns tier progression: simple iron/silver; tempered steel teal trim; runic violet silver; dawnsteel pale gold cyan; legendary sunsteel rich gold orange. Each successive tier changes ornate silhouette and detailing. Rows top to bottom EXACTLY: 1 swords; 2 fitted plate cuirasses; 3 war sigil pendants; 4 bows; 5 leather brigandine torso armor; 6 eagle seal artifacts; 7 cavalry lances; 8 rider mail torso armor; 9 wind crest artifacts; 10 healer staffs; 11 healer vestments; 12 life talismans; 13 siege ammunition (iron ball, spiked steel ball, violet rune orb, cyan crystal shell, flaming gold meteor); 14 abstract fortification doctrines (rolled military blueprints and defensive rune tablets, NOT wearable armor); 15 siege compass artifacts. Weapons can angle diagonally to fill each wide cell while staying strictly within cell. Every row exactly 5 icons, every column exactly15. This is one precisely registered spritesheet for programmatic slicing, spacing and cell registration paramount. Truly transparent alpha.
